description: As an Intern at the UNTAR Data and Information Technology Center, I fully contributed to the LINTAR academic management system. My responsibilities included modernizing the system's interface to be more responsive and user-friendly, as well as enhancing backend security and performance for more efficient execution, all while collaborating closely within a cross-functional team.

In my role as Scrum Master, I led a development team in building the "UploadItIn" web application for essay grading. By implementing the SCRUM methodology, I successfully increased the project's development efficiency by 2-3 times compared to standard methods.

As Project Lead, I led and managed a development team from concept to deployment in creating the "Outfitology" fashion inspiration website. I was responsible for ensuring the team's productivity and efficiency throughout the development process.
